notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are bringing you the newest update!

Changes;
-Changed in-game audio effects
-Added an audio effect when burning a toy
-Improved multiplayer AI
-Drastically improved loading times for both multiplayer and singleplayer
-Optimized CPU usage 

Notes;
We will be keeping the peer to peer multiplayer system for now and we will try to improve it even further.

Thank you all for purchasing the game, if you experience any issues during gameplay please report  back to us!

Yours truly,
Chonky Games

notes.title: Performance update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we bring you a smaller update regarding performance.

-some internal issues have been fixed so the performance should be a lot better now.

We are working on a next update already, we will also change the networking system from "peer 2 peer" to dedicated servers since we read that players are experiencing issues with multiplayer.

We are also working on a big update for the AI.

Hold on tight!

Yours truly,
Chonky Games
